tagline.zh: 字阶的数学底座:size(n)=base×ratioⁿ 几何级数出层级、calc() 链式同轴缩放、Utopia 流体 clamp——斜率走 vw、截距藏 rem、两端钳制,一行 CSS 就是一段线性回归。
tagline.en: The math under type scales: size(n)=base×ratioⁿ builds hierarchy, calc() chains keep spacing co-axial, and Utopia's fluid clamp — slope in vw, intercept hidden in rem, both ends clamped — is a linear regression in one line of CSS.

origin.zh: 模数尺概念出自 Robert Bringhurst《The Elements of Typographic Style》的和谐比例观,由 Tim Brown 在 A List Apart 2011《More Meaningful Typography》推广——比率取音乐音程命名,含 1:1.618 黄金比示例与模数尺构造法(本次抓取原文核对);流体 clamp 公式经调研对 utopia.fyi 页面 bundle 反查还原,并与页面真实输出逐字符对拍(调研 14§1)。
origin.en: The modular scale descends from Robert Bringhurst's harmonic-proportion view in The Elements of Typographic Style, popularized by Tim Brown's 'More Meaningful Typography' (A List Apart, 2011) — ratios named after musical intervals, with a 1:1.618 golden-ratio example (original fetched and checked); the fluid clamp formula was reverse-engineered from utopia.fyi's production bundle and verified character-for-character against the page's real output (research 14 §1).

effect.zh: 字阶基值(step-0 在 minVw 处的字号),demo 用它实跑 size(n)=base×ratioⁿ。默认 16px 对应调研核验的阶梯(base=16, ratio=1.25 → 10.24/12.8/16/20/25);改成 18 可复现 Utopia 黄金样本 step-0 clamp(1.125rem, 1.0739rem + 0.2273vw, 1.25rem)。
effect.en: Scale base (step-0's size at minVw); the demo runs size(n)=base×ratioⁿ live. Default 16px matches the verified ladder (base=16, ratio=1.25 → 10.24/12.8/16/20/25); set 18 to reproduce Utopia's golden sample clamp(1.125rem, 1.0739rem + 0.2273vw, 1.25rem).

effect.zh: 倍率比率表(音乐音程命名,Bringhurst/Tim Brown 传统)。1.25 是调研标注的『最常用的 UI 排版比率』;1.067 适合密集 UI 微调,1.5/1.618 适合展示型页面。JS 型参数,demo 解析为数值实跑几何级数。
effect.en: The ratio table (musical-interval naming, Bringhurst/Tim Brown tradition). 1.25 is the research's 'most-used UI type ratio'; 1.067 suits dense UI tweaks, 1.5/1.618 display pages. JS-type param — the demo parses it and runs the geometric series live.

effect.zh: 向上生成的级数;demo 始终展示 step−1 到 step+steps 的完整阶梯(负 n 为下行阶梯)。
effect.en: How many steps to grow upward; the demo always shows the full ladder from step−1 to step+steps (negative n = descending rungs).

effect.zh: 流体插值下端视口(Utopia 页面默认 360)。与 minViewport 搭配决定 slope=(max−min)/(maxVw−minVw) 的斜率。
effect.en: Lower viewport stop of the fluid interpolation (Utopia's page default is 360). Together with maxViewport it sets slope=(max−min)/(maxVw−minVw).

effect.zh: 流体插值上端视口(Utopia 页面默认 1240)。等于 minViewport 时斜率除零——demo 会给出边界提示而非输出 Infinity。
effect.en: Upper viewport stop of the fluid interpolation (Utopia's page default is 1240). Equal to minViewport it divides by zero — the demo shows a bounds note instead of Infinity.

note.zh: calc() 是全 evergreen 支持的成熟特性;clamp() 亦已全 evergreen(Can I use 记载 Chrome 79+/Firefox 75+/Safari 13.1+,社区口径,本调研未逐版本核验)。rem 换算依赖根字号——fluidClamp 默认按 16px 折算,根字号不同的站点需传 remBase。
note.en: calc() is supported by every evergreen browser; clamp() likewise (Can I use lists Chrome 79+/Firefox 75+/Safari 13.1+ — community data, not version-audited in this research). rem conversion assumes a 16px root — pass remBase on sites with a different root font size.

fallback.zh: 不支持 clamp() 的旧浏览器:在 @supports not (width: clamp(1px, 1vw, 2px)) 里给每个 --step-* 写静态 px 值(minVw 处的取值),布局退化为固定字阶而非断点跳变;calc() 链无需回退。
fallback.en: For browsers without clamp(): inside @supports not (width: clamp(1px, 1vw, 2px)), write static px values (the minVw reading) for each --step-* — the layout degrades to a fixed scale, not a breakpoint jump. The calc() chain needs no fallback.

use.zh: 设计系统字阶一次性推导:一个 base、一个 ratio 生成全部 --step-*
use.en: One-shot derivation of a design-system type scale: one base, one ratio, all --step-* tokens

use.zh: 无断点流体排版:标题在 360–1240px 视口间线性呼吸(Fluid Type Scale 条目的数学内核)
use.en: Breakpoint-free fluid type: headings breathe linearly across 360–1240px viewports (the math inside the Fluid Type Scale entry)

use.zh: 间距/行高与字号同轴:calc() 链让派生量跟随同一 --ratio 自乘
use.en: Co-axial spacing and leading: the calc() chain multiplies one --ratio through every derived token

use.zh: 设计评审时反查:给定 clamp 串还原 slope/intercept,判断是否越界
use.en: Review-time audit: recover slope/intercept from a clamp string and check it stays in bounds

avoid.zh: 层级超过 4–5 级后继续乘 ratio——级差指数爆炸,step+3 在 16/1.25 已达 31px,再乘两倍率脱档
avoid.en: Multiplying ratio past 4–5 levels — gaps explode exponentially; step+3 at 16/1.25 is already 31px

avoid.zh: minVw/maxVw 覆盖不到的视口依赖插值(两端本就是钳制值,超界等于浪费)
avoid.en: Expecting interpolation outside [minVw, maxVw] — both ends are clamps, out-of-range viewports get constants

avoid.zh: 把比率调到 1.067 以下做正文——相邻级肉眼不可分,层级失效
avoid.en: Body-text ratios under 1.067 — adjacent steps become indistinguishable and hierarchy dies

avoid.zh: 根字号非 16px 时直接套用按 16 折算的 rem 输出——换算错位一整档
avoid.en: Using 16-based rem output on a site whose root font size is not 16px — everything shifts a notch

a11y.zh: 用户缩放文本(浏览器最小字号、Dynamic Type)时,px 基值的字阶不跟随——优先用 rem 表达 base 与 --step-*,只在 clamp 的斜率里用 vw;WCAG 1.4.4 要求页面支持 200% 文本放大,固定 px 字阶+固定容器会造成溢出,流体 rem+vw 方案天然兼容。
a11y.en: When users scale text (browser minimum font size, Dynamic Type), a px-based scale does not follow — express base and --step-* in rem, reserving vw for the clamp slope only; WCAG 1.4.4 requires 200% text zoom, and a fixed px scale in a fixed container overflows, while fluid rem+vw adapts natively.

goal.zh: 用几何级数 + calc() 链 + Utopia 流体 clamp 生成一套字阶 token:step−1..step+3,全部派生自一个 base 与一个 ratio,输出可直接粘贴的 CSS 自定义属性。
goal.en: Generate a type-scale token set with the geometric series + calc() chain + Utopia fluid clamp: step−1..step+3, all derived from one base and one ratio, output as paste-ready CSS custom properties.

acceptance.zh: 每个字号都有出处:size(n)=base×ratioⁿ,逐步列出 n 与结果
acceptance.en: Every size is traceable: size(n)=base×ratioⁿ, listing n and the result step by step

acceptance.zh: clamp 串按 slope=(max−min)/(maxVw−minVw)、intercept=min−slope×minVw 推导,截距藏 rem、斜率走 vw
acceptance.en: Derive each clamp via slope=(max−min)/(maxVw−minVw) and intercept=min−slope×minVw — intercept in rem, slope in vw

acceptance.zh: calc() 链式生成:--step-1: calc(var(--step-0) * var(--ratio)),乘法一侧必须无单位
acceptance.en: Chain with calc(): --step-1: calc(var(--step-0) * var(--ratio)); one side of each multiplication must be unitless

acceptance.zh: 间距与行高与字阶同源(同一 --ratio),不要另起一套魔法数
acceptance.en: Spacing and line-height share the same --ratio as the scale — no second set of magic numbers

acceptance.zh: 负阶梯显式写出 --step--1 而不是用负值字号
acceptance.en: Write --step--1 explicitly rather than negative font sizes
